title: listings.purchasables
description: Keyed batch of listings as purchasables (the stapel-orders resolver contract). Output: {key: {title, price, currency, available, max_quantity, seller_id, image, url}}; price is a 2-dp decimal string; max_quantity is the stock for countable listings, else null; absent keys are unknown (no such listing, soft-deleted, or unpriced).
